title: Kaunda out of jail but under house arrest
article_text:
LUSAKA, December 31: Jailed Zambian ex-leader Kenneth Kaunda, held under emergency powers over a foiled coup plot, will be freed from prison today and placed under house arrest, President Frederick Chiluba announced.

Chiluba said he would sign an order later today to release Kaunda, 73, after he had received “reasonable requests” from Tanzanian envoy Julius Nyerere and President Robert Mugabe of Zimbabwe. The decision to free Kaunda from a notorious high security prison he has been held in sinceChristmasday was reached following an emergency cabinet meeting last night, prompted by direct appeals from retired Tanzanian leader Nyerere and Mugabe, who is current chairman of the Organisation of African Unity (OAU).

Earlier, Kaunda refused to plead guilty in a court here and accused the ruling regime of plotting to “liquidate” him. The leader of the country’s largest Opposition party told the court he was arrested “to settle political accounts” and did not rule out the “possibility of physical liquidation” by the ruling regime, which has accused him of plotting to overthrow President Frederick Chiluba. The 73-year-old leader, who ruled Zambia with an iron hand from the country’s Independence in 1964 until he was ousted from his post in 1991’s first multi-party polls denies any connection with the failed October coup.

He has ended his hunger strike, Tanzania’s former President Julius Nyerere, who has been asked by several African leaders to mediate Kaunda’s release, said. “Together we had a nice drink of orange juice and a little biscuit. He broke his fast,” Nyerere told reporters after a meeting with old friend Kaunda at the prison in the town of Kabwe.

Meanwhile, according to reports from Washington, the United States today kept up pressure for Kaunda’s release.

title: Protest day’ by teachers on Jan 12
article_text:
CHANDIGARH, January 8: The executive of the Panjab University Teachers’ Association (PUTA) has decided to observe January 12 as a day of protest in response to a call given by the All India Federation of University and College Teachers’ Organisation (AIFUCTO).

PUTA secretary Rana Nayar said the teachers are protesting the failure of the Centre to release new pay-scales for teachers. However, teaching work would not be affected.

title: Ashok Leyland downgraded
article_text:
MUMBAI, January 1: Four debenture programmes of Ashok Leyland, worth Rs 526 crores has been downgraded by the Credit Rating Information Services of India Ltd (Crisil) due to the company’s high degree of vulnerability due to cyclical fluctuation in automobile industry.

The flagship company of the Hinduja group has incurred a loss of Rs 32 crore on a total turnover of Rs 819 crores during the first six months ended September 30, 1997.Other factors that affected the downgrading of Leyland included sharp decline in sales volume and the weakening financial risk profile of the company as reflected in the increased debt levels and declining coverage ratios. The fixed deposit programme of the company has also been downgraded.

The rating of Rs 24.2 crore Non-Convertible Debentures (NCD), Rs 20 crore NCD (Series IX), Rs 232 crore Partially Convertible Debentures and Rs 250 crore NCD issued byAshok Leylandhas been downgraded from AA+ to AA. The company’s networth stands at Rs 1030 crore as on September 1997. The revised rating indicates high safety with regard to timely payment of interest and principal. The FAA+’ rating assigned to the fixed deposit programme of Leyland has been downgraded to FAA’. P1+’ rating has been assigned to the company Rs 75 crore commercial paper programme indicating that the degree of safety with timely payment on the instrument is very strong.

Crisil has also has downgraded the rating of Rs. 9.75 crore Deep Discount Bonds of Lloyds Steel Industries Ltd — flagship of the Lloyds group — to C’ from BB’ indicating the company is vulnerable to default as it has incurred a cash loss of Rs 33.7 crore during the first half ended September 30, 1997. The company is expected to make further cash losses for the year 1997-98. “The rating factors in the continual deterioration in credit quality due to poor profitability from the steel business arising out of poor demand offtake, low international steel prices for flat steel products and high cost operations”, said Crisil.

The NCD issue of Pennar Alumninium Company Ltd (PALCO) worth Rs 28.2 crores has been downgraded to D'(default category) from BB indicating that the instrument is in default or is expected to default on maturity. “The revised rating reflects the company’s strained financial position on account of severe competition from imports, reduction in import duty and unremunerative prices for its scrips,” said a Crisil statement.

Pennar is engaged in the manufacture and sale of aluminium strips and conductors.

title: BJP lashes out after Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind President Arshad Madani claims discrimination of Muslims in India
article_text:
Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind President Arshad Madani’s remarks on discrimination of Muslims in India has been met with sharp criticism, with the BJP accusing him of of looting the country’s minorities and resorting to blame-game politics.

In a video posted on X, Madani said that many around the world believe Muslims are “helpless” or “finished”. Citing examples such as Zohran Mamdani, the newly-elected Mayor of New York, and Sadiq Khan, the Mayor of London, Madani argued that Muslims are indeed capable of leadership roles. He said, “The world thinks that Muslims are helpless, but I don’t think so. A Muslim can become a mayor of New York, a Khan can become the mayor of London, but in India—a Muslim cannot even become a vice-chancellor of a university.”

Madani went on to claim that if a Muslim in India does manage to become a vice-chancellor, he will end up in jail likeAzam Khan. Referring to the founder of Al-Falah university, which is under scanner after three doctors working there were named suspects in the red Fort blast case, Madani said: “Look at what is happening in Al-Falah. The founder, Jawad Siddiqui, is in jail, and who knows how many years he will have to be there,” Madani said.

धर्म के आधार पर लोगों को बांटने से देश कमज़ोर हो रहा है। जो हो रहा है, उसे देखकर लगता है कि फिरकापरस्त ताकतें इस्लाम और मुसलमानों दोनों को खत्म करने पर तुली हुई हैं। लेकिन शायद उन्हें यह नहीं पता कि इस्लाम का यह चिराग कभी नहीं बुझेगा और जिन्होंने इसे बुझाने की कोशिश की, वे खुद…pic.twitter.com/d8ot48mdVS

— Arshad Madani (@ArshadMadani007)November 22, 2025

He alleged that the Indian government has actively prevented Muslims from taking leadership positions. “Since independence, the government has been working to prevent Muslims from rising, hence people say Muslims do not have leadership qualities,” Madani said.

Reacting sharply to Madani’s comment, BJP leader Mohsin Raza said that Madani and his family have looted the country’s Muslims and played blame-game politics. “Arshad Madani and his family have looted the country’s Muslims and played blame-game politics.

“This has been their dual character for a very long time. They kept receiving grants in the name of Muslim minorities for years but did nothing for them,” he added.

Congress leader Udit Raj expressed support to Madani over his comments, saying that for mistakes of some people, the entire community should not be targeted. “I support his statement…I agree that someone has done terrorist activity in the Al-Falah University, but the university should not be targeted,” he said.

Speaking to ANI, Raj questioned as to why the entire community is being targeted and why are the houses of Muslims being razed. “Why are homes of Muslims being bulldozed? America is great, as there is no discrimination there. There is discrimination based on caste, religion”

title: The Family Man Season 3 Review LIVE Updates: Manoj Bajpayee confirms Season 4 of spy drama, says ‘Sabka jawab 4th season me hoga’
article_text:
The Family Man 3 Web Series Review Live Updates:The third season of Amazon Prime Video series The Family Man is finally out, and fans around the world are tuning in to see what’s next in Srikant Tiwari’s journey. Tiwari, portrayed by Manoj Bajpayee, has foiled several terrorist plans in the past, but this time, things are a little different. In a dramatic twist, Srikant must now step into the role of the fugitive and go into hiding. The super-agent is forced to stay off the radar while protecting his wife and their two children.

The Family Man 3 Review: Read Here

These unnatural turns of events have been orchestrated by the antagonist Meera, played by actor Nimrat Kaur. She is also using Rukma, played by Jaideep Ahlawat, to make inroads into Northeastern India. Moreover, this time Srikant’s battle against the villains will be much more challenging because, according to the trailer, he has now revealed his true job to his family. Which means that it’s more likely for his family to get caught in the crossfire.

Some things are luckily the same as before. Srikant still has his field partner, J. K. Talpade, played by Sharib Hashmi. Talpade still trusts Srikant and does seem to be holding his own in the trailer while also being chaotically anxious about everything. In this season, Srikant will have to choose between safety and duty. Choosing safety would mean the whole family leaving behind their life and hiding for the rest of their days. Duty would mean taking Rukma and Meera head-on in order to foil their schemes and clear his name.

Directed by Raj and DK, the cast of The Family Man season 3 includes Manoj Bajpayee, Jaideep Ahlawat, Nimrat Kaur, Priyamani, Sharib Hashmi, Ashlesha Thakur, Vedant Sinha, Seema Biswas, Gul Panag, Jugal Hansraj and Vipin Sharma.

User @AdityaRawat1997 took to X and wrote, "Completed Season 3 of The Family Man, and @rajndk world-building continues to impress. They create a universe that feels so real, layered, and engaging. @BajpayeeManoj as Srikant Tiwari single-handedly carries the show with sheer brilliance. His banter with JK aka @sharibhashm adds such a fun. Even the villain has some emotional depth, and the entire cast delivers good performances. @Sumitaroraa dialogues are a standout—witty, fun, and packed with sharp humor. They remain one of the strongest pillars of the show. A fun little cameo pops up in the show-totally enjoyable. Overall, a fun watch—but it’s a slow burn. Stay patient, and it turns into a good ride with a cliffhanger in the finale."

User @DevBilla2 shared on X, "I just wrapped up The Family Man Season 3, and wow, the team has absolutely leveled up the game. Excellent taking from #sumanthkumar.From storytelling to performances, Everything is good. Kudos to @BajpayeeManoj and the entire crew for delivering another masterclass."

A tweed by user @amitabhlaloriya read, "BINGEWATCHED! Why do you do this @rajndk? You are simply the best in creating such cliffhangers of stories! I too, like millions of @BajpayeeManoj die hard fans, desperately waiting for the Season -3 and the desperation - the anxiousness and the restlessness is multi times high after the seventh episode ended!! What to do now ? How could you leave Srikant Tiwari in such a condition? What a crazy ensemble of artists! @sharibhashmi is such a fabulous actor and so much endearing is his character in this story! #priyamani is such a terrific actor and it feels that no one else can play this role of Suchi as perfectly as she does! What to talk of your twisted mind that you made a menacing and hate- worthy character of Rukma out of an actor like @JaideepAhlawat who is so bloody good and loved for his sheer genius! It was too difficult to accept him as such a bad guy! Same for @NimratOfficial! She is a great actor and shines through every act, even if it was something like this one! That’s all is still manageable but HOW does one wait to know how is Srikant Tiwari now ? Has he been picked up in time by the army or some saviour?? Please do something quick and fast, Raj & DK!! Bring the SEASON 4 asap! Take A Bow, Team Family Man."

User @Nithish_017 said via X, "Finally watched the most awaited Season 3 this weekend — and Raj & DK have once again levelled up the game on @PrimeVideoIN! This season dives deep into the North-East conflict, deep-state manipulation, 0.5 enemies within, China border tensions, and the brainwashing of border towns. Loved the subtle digs at language learning sarcasm and woke campaigns. The show also beautifully portrays the emotional battles of NIA families — the courage, the distance, the togetherness. Performances: • Manoj Bajpayee as Srikant Tiwari — one of the most legendary characters ever written. Iconic. • Jaideep Ahlawat as Rukma is a beast — his sarcastic alpha energy is a treat. Watching these two share screen space = goosebumps! • Sharib Hashmi (JK… Just JK) once again steals the show with humour + chemistry with Srikant. • Priyamani, Ashlesha Thakur, Vedant Sinha, Nimrat Kaur, Seema Biswas — everyone delivers solid performances. • Massive respect to all North Eastern artists for their brilliant work! There’s even a special cameo from another Raj & DK universe…(Crossover loading?) What didn’t work: A new character introduced as a “mole” felt absolutely unnecessary and added no weight to the plot. The season ends with a big cliffhanger, hinting that this North-East arc is just the beginning. Makers… please release the next season ASAP!"

User @umakanthonline posted on X, "Watched #familymanseason3. Its intense, and exactly what a good thriller should be. @BajpayeeManoj once again proves that strong acting doesn’t need noise...just honesty. The story is gripping, the action is clean, and the emotional moments land perfectly by #rajdk. The show reminds us of one simple truth: Life keeps throwing challenges, but staying focused and steady is what makes you a real fighter ...just like Srikant Tiwari. A perfect weekend watch...Honestly all emotions in simple way. 4.5/10 ..Strong, grounded, and worth every minute."

On Saturday, a fan @aman_kharbas took to his X account and wrote, “Binged Season 3 of Family Man whole day, and you guys left it on such a cliffhanger! Not done @rajndk At least tell us, Is the season over or you guys will be releasing the left episodes later? Kudos for the great work BTW.”

In his response, Manoj Bajpayee said, “Sabka jawab 4th season me hoga! Jaldi milte ha (All answers will be given in 4th season! Meet you soon)!”

User @tushar_bed shared via X, "Just watched #thefamilyman3. absolute CLASSIC!! Brilliant performances across the cast. A must-watch for sure."

User @aman_kharbas said via X, "Binged Season 3 of Family Man whole day, and you guys left it on such a cliffhanger! Not done @rajndk At least tell us, Is the season over or you guys will be releasing the left episodes later? Kudos for the great work BTW."

User @Arunji_Official shared on X, "More superficial, more politically charged, less exciting installment compared to previous ones, okayish cameos...! Overall a bit sluggish, but watchable. Jaideep did great."

A tweet by @kalyaniTweetz read, "#familyman season3 is the weakest in the series so far. Overly stretched, not a strong script.. no highs in the execution. On top of it, incomplete ending.. no satisfaction after finishing watching it. @BajpayeeManoj as usual was soo good like he was born to play this role."

User @adarsh_2193 posted on X, "Just finished #familyman S3 and it felt like a 7-episode slog with no real payoff. Plot wandered, ending fizzled, and the convenient corruption angle got tiring fast. Only bright spot? Vijay Sethupathi walking in, stealing the moment, and vanishing way too soon."

A tweet by @rockstarsads read, "Family Man Season 3 is definitely watchable, with superb acting from everyone. But the ending was disappointing, especially after waiting 4 years for this season. Overall, a solid 7/10. #familymanseason3."

X user @TheBabyDoc48 shared, "#thefamilymanonprime is one of the masterclass by Raj & DK on how to make a wonderful spy thriller, continue it with multiple seasons and still keep the audience so excited and hooked to your story. Jaideep Ahlawat adds extra spice to the show, Manoj Bajpayee and Sharib Hashmi continue their on screen magic from the previous two seasons and so do Priyamani and the two kids, especially Atharv. Do watch it, just relax, popcorn, a drink and enjoy. @PrimeVideoIN"

X user @beingshivam_90 tweeted, "#thefamilyman3 expands its scale with a heavy geopolitical backdrop. The plot revolves around Project Sahakar, India’s answer to China’s covert Project Guan Yu, which involves creating “phoenix villages” along the Indo-Myanmar border. The setup is detailed and connects multiple threads, but at times it feels like the show explains a bit too much, making the classic Family Man tone less noticeable compared to the first two seasons. The strong performance by #nimratkaur and #jaideepahlawat really stand out, and #vijaysethupathi’s special appearance adds weight but is not convincing. #manojbajpayee & #priyamani deliver good performance but the spark is missing. However, the ending feels predictable and somewhat wasted, finishing with a typical cliffhanger that leaves many things open for Season 4. #shreyadhanwanthary love-angle subplot also feels unnecessary. Overall, it is good but missing the tightness and charm of the earlier seasons. Now Waiting For Season 4."

X user @siva1999stark posted, "#thefamilyman3 - Not as prolific as S1 or at least as good as S2. Weakest Season among all. Expected more. This felt more like a setup than past seasons. Some parts are good but there are no standout episodes here compared to the last 2 seasons."

Ever since Family Man Season 3 promotions started, the cast including Manoj Bajpayee and directors Raj and DK were asked about whether the show will have a season 4. While the trio kept their options open, Family Man season 3's ending has confirmed that a next season is in the offing. As the series ended on a cliffhanger, we will eventually get a The Family Man season 4.

A fan singled out the episode 2 of Family Man season 3, saying that it has the best action of the entire season. "Watch out for an action scene featuring Manoj Bajpayee with Jaideep Ahlawat. It is by far the best moment in the season and this episode is a dhamaka," wrote a fan on X.

While Manoj Bajpayee-Jaideep Ahlawat's The Family Man season 3 is getting a lot of interest from viewers. The show landed on Friday morning and people have already binge watched it. Some, however, had an issue with Family Man Season 3 climax. "It ends abruptly," complained many.

A recent post on X read, "The Family Man (Season 3) Review [ 3.5 / 5 ⭐ ] This season addresses a national-security threat involving insurgency and covert operations beyond India. Action choreography is sharp, performances enhance the writing, ending feels abrupt and half cooked. An engaging watch."

X user @Sharatsays2 posted, "#thefamilyman3 #thefamilymanonprime has been fully binge-watched, and it reminds me why this franchise which kicked off a new era in 2019 - remains one of my all-time favorite web series. Season 3 dives deeper into the family’s internal struggles while weaving them into the larger mission. The first three episodes are crisp and engaging, though the mid-season pacing dips and its boring in episodes 4 and 5. The finale however, ties everything together beautifully and delivers a satisfying payoff. The making, writing, and emotional beats stay true to the franchise’s standa…

A The Family Man Season review on X read, "While I wrapped up an intense midnight to early morning binge of The Family Man 3 on @PrimeVideoIN, and I have to say among all three seasons, this one easily stands out as the most complete and compelling package yet."

A review of The Family Man Season 3  on X read, "The #familyman Season 3 felt like the weakest work from #rajanddk. Story was okay but the execution was very slow. Cameos worked well. Performances by #manojbajpayee & #jaideepahlawat were the biggest positives.#sharibhashmi’s character felt irritating. Abrupt ending—waiting for Season 4. Didn’t like it overall, but you can try it if interested."

A user @techsavysam posted on X, "#thefamilymanseason3 It was good, but could’ve been better. This time Srikant Tiwari nailed his role as the wanted man but fell a little short as the family man. Raj & DK’s universe is on🔥 the cameos were excellent. That ending they really left it hanging."

X page @TrackTwood shared Family Man Season 3 Review which reads, "Raj & DK are back, and they deliver again. #thefamilyman3 is a gripping, tightly-packed spy thriller that races through 7 crisp episodes without losing focus for a second. This season expands the universe in smart ways, keep an eye out for clever Easter eggs and some truly fun cameos. A binge-worthy return for Srikant Tiwari."

A fan @vishalandcinema shared via X, "Done with first two episodes of Family Man S3. The stakes are already high! Hoping for another great season ahead."

In an exclusive interview with SCREEN, The Family Man actors Manoj Bajpayee, Priyamani, Jaideep Ahlawat, and Nimrat Kaur, and creators Raj & DK talk about season 3, crafting its formidable antagonists, and the inescapable ghost of the past that is: "What happened in Lonavala?"

X user @prattweets10 posted his review for Manoj Bajpayee and Sharib Hashmi's show and wrote, "The Family Man 3 my favorite indian show returns- with great new additions and a story set in the north-east. Not as outspoken about issues as in the past but still subtle. I missed the signature 1 shot sequence. It felt like half a season and that ending...oh! but but but..I have to believe this isn't all. I loved all the twists and the cameos too. I'm sure @rajndk will come back hard (if they do). @BajpayeeManoj is always brilliant as he is. I loved @shreyadhan13 being as sharp as she was vulnerable. Ahlawat and Kaur were quite good to see. I liked the new season quite much but not too sure I loved it. If it was any other show, I would have, but I held The Family Man to its own standards. I binged it non-stop. It's really good. But was I as moved as S1 & S2? Not quite."

While the much-awaited Manoj Bajpayee's gripping show continues to perform well, earning strong viewership and critical appreciation, fans wonder if Prime Video and the show makers will come up with The Family Man Season 4, which they have not announced  yet. Based on the release timeline so far - Season 1 in 2019, Season 2 in 2021, and Season 3 in November 2025 - the series usually returns after long production gaps.

X user @RajkrisMenon shared his review for The Family Man Season 3 and wrote, "Weakest season yet... But at least the cast is clearly in control and having fun on the job. Always liked this series for striking the right balance between spy thriller and family drama. For the most part, anyway. #familyman #thefamilymans3 #manojbajpai."

A fan @D_Mayur_P posted Family Man Season 3 Review on X that read, "The Family Man Season 3 is very watchable and delivers much of what fans of the series expect ..solid performances, gripping action, family drama. But it falls slightly short of being exceptional, especially compared with the earlier seasons. If you’re a fan of the series, you’ll likely enjoy this chapter. If you’re coming fresh, you’ll probably still have a good time."

The Indian Express' Shubhra Gupra gave the new season of The Family Mam 2.5 stars, and wrote in her The Family Man 3 review, "Manoj Bajpayee is still the beating heart of the show, as is Sharib Hashmi as his trusty second-in-command; Priyamani continues to be as watchable too. The problem really is the way this much-anticipated season starts off with a bang, and then slackens and peters out as it goes along. And that has nothing to do with the actors, who go wherever the script wants to take them: Manoj Bajpayee is still the beating heart of the show, as is Sharib Hashmi as his trusty second-in-command."

Family man season 3 cast sees the return of Manoj Bajpayee, Sharib Hashmi, Priyamani, Aslesha Thakur, Vedant Sinha, Seema Biswas,  Shreya Dhanwantry and Dilip Tahil. They are also joined by Nimrat Kaur, Jaideep Ahlawat, and Jugal Hansraj.

Manoj Tiwari-Sharib Hashmi-Priyamani's The Family Man season 3 landed on prime Video at 12 midnight on Friday. The show is created and directed by Raj and DK.

Family Man Season 3 returns with a total of seven episodes. The action now finds Manoj Bajpayee's Srikant Tiwari in Nagaland even as he runs from a mole in his own house, TASC.

title: Leopard skins seized
article_text:
NAGPUR, Dec 31: Three leopard skins, estimated to be worth over Rs 2.5 lakh, were seized by the Dhantoli police from a man on Monday.

According to police, Bahadursingh Behadasingh Rajput Thakur was intercepted by the patrol staff of Dhantoli police around 9.30 am while he was loitering around in a suspicious manner. When asked what he was carrying in a tiffin box and a handbag, Rajput gave evasive replies. A search revealed the three leopard skins.

The police have handed over the case to the Forest authorities for further investigations.

title: World Vignettes
article_text:
Spice Girls voted the worst band

LONDON: Readers of the British pop newspaper Melody Maker have voted top pop groups Oasis and the Spice Girls as the worst bands of 1997. Ginger Spice, whose real name is Geri Halliwell, was also branded least sexy female while Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher was voted least sexy man and fool of the year. The poll by Melody Maker suggested that Radiohead and The Verve were set to take over the top spots in the battle of the bands. Readers of the music weekly voted Radiohead as best band. The Spice Girls were named as the worst, with Oasis in second place. Melody Maker editor Mark Sutherland said: “Our readers have a well deserved reputation for being ahead of the pack so, on reading these results, I’m sure Radiohead and The Verve will be popping the champagne corks while Oasis and the Spice Girls will be trembling in their boots.”

SYDNEY: Australian scientists have announced that they have developed the world’s first gene map for prawns, as the first step towards developing bigger, faster-growing crustaceans. The team from the Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organization (CSIRO) said on Tuesday that the genetic linkage map was the first for any crustacean species and will be used to identify traits of flesh quality, disease resistance and growth rate. Using the map as a guide, large increases in the rate of genetic improvement of farmed prawns are possible, a statement from the CSIRO said.

MOSCOW: Seven Chechen journalists who had been held hostage for nine days were released on Wednesday in the Russian Republic of Daghestan in the northern Caucasus, the Moscow news agency Itar-Tass reported. The reporters, some of whom were under contract to foreign news organisations, were seized while covering clashes between rebels and Russian forces in the Daghestan town of Buynaksk.

SYDNEY: Hundreds of frozen embryos will be destroyed on Thursday under new laws in the Australian state of Victoria, while hundreds more have a three-month reprieve as doctors search for donor couples. Under Victoria’s new in-vitro fertilisation (IVF) laws which will come into effect from Thursday, any IVF embryo unused for five years must be defrosted and destroyed. But the infertility treatment authority, the state’s regulatory body, has given couples three months to seek an exemption from the new IVF law.

LHASA: Seventeen secluded islands in Tibet autonomous region have turned into virtually heaven’ for birds, harbouring thousands of birds including several rare species. A six-year survey conducted by Chinese experts has revealed that Tibet has more bird islands than previously imagined and most of the 17 bird islands, each with an area of one hectare, are scattered far and wide on the lakes at 4,200-5,000 metres high above sea level, Liu Wulin, a wild-animal expert said on Wednesday.

Thousands of birds dwell on the islands, including rare species such as brown-headed sea gulls, Liu said adding there was an average of one or two rare birds, or ten sea gulls for every square metre of the island.

title: Detailed study of N-E monsoon needed
article_text:
PUNE, Dec 31: Renowned meteorologist Prof G C Asnani stressed about the need to understand and study in detail the dynamics of the North East monsoon affecting the country, until now a neglected area.

Speaking at the Annual Monsoon Workshop – 1997 organised by thePuneChapter of the Indian Meteorological Society at the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology on Monday, Asnani said the time had come to expand the definition of monsoon since monsoon was not restricted to Asia and Africa alone. Nine papers dealing with various aspects of the monsoon this year were presented by meteorological scientists at the workshop. Panel discussions were held to deliberate on various issues relating to monsoon.

The presentations highlighted the unusual swings in the rain pattern which differed on a week-to-week basis. The scientists observed that during the monsoons, rains were recorded above normal for seven weeks and below normal for 11 weeks.

Elaborating on circulation and sea surface temperature anomalies during this year’s monsoon, A B Mazumdar of India Meteorological Department said the South-West monsoon started with widespread apprehension about the possible adverse effect of El Nino. The fear, he said, deepened further because of late onset over Kerala and subsequent below normal activity of rainfall in the first two months of the season. However, the cumulative rainfall received became normal in the second half of August and the season ended with marginally above normal rainfall, he added.

title: Kolkata hotel murder: CA was found dead naked with his legs tied; father says he had no enemies
article_text:
The police investigating the death of chartered accountant Adarsh Losalka at a hotel in the Rajdanga area of Kasba in Kolkata said on Sunday that his body was found naked, with his legs tied using a towel, and a deep gash on the back of his head, adding that several condoms were also recovered from the room.

Tracking the timeline using CCTV footage, the police said that Losalka, 33, who had booked two rooms online, entered the hotel around 8.30 pm on Friday, along with another man and a woman. While Losalka entered one room, the other two went to the other room. Around 9 pm, the man and woman went to Losalka’s room. They exited the room and left the hotel around 2.30 am.

Manoj Kumar Verma, Commissioner of Police,Kolkata, said on Sunday, “Investigations are on and we are trying to locate the other two persons who had accompanied him.”

The police suspect that Losalka had been hit from behind and strangled, but are awaiting the postmortem report.

“The victim’s mobile phone and wallet were missing. We think that the suspects have taken the wallet and mobile with them. We are checking whether money was withdrawn from Losalka’s bank account after the murder,” said a senior police officer.

Police sources said that Losalka’s social media accounts, including WhatsApp, had been deactivated after the murder.

The police, who have questioned the hotel staff, also said they were verifying the Aadhaar cards that the two suspects had submitted while checking in.

Speaking to the media on Sunday, Losalka’s father Bimal Kumar Losalka said, “My son loved to travel and was a very jolly person. He never had any enemies. On Friday, he spoke to me for two minutes and said he was out for work and would meet some friends. After that, we could not reach him. He had told me recently that he was getting a promotion and a raise, which some of his colleagues did not like. Otherwise, everything was fine.”

Losalka, whose body was recovered on Saturday afternoon from the hotel room, hailed from Dubrajpur in Birbhum. He worked in a private company in Kolkata and used to stay with his friends in a rented apartment in the city.

In October, the decomposed body of a man who had checked into a hotel on Rafi Ahmed Kidwai Road in the city was found hidden under a bed after the next guest complained of an “unbearable stench”. The police then suspected that he had been killed by two men who had accompanied him while checking in.

On Sunday, Verma also said the police would prepare guidelines for hotels on how they should remain vigilant so that such incidents could be prevented in the future.

title: UP Muslims irked by Kalyan order on "Vande Mataram"
article_text:
LUCKNOW, Jan 1: All primary school students in the State will have to start their day by “worshipping a portrait of Bharat Mata” and reciting “Vande Mataram.” And during roll call, a student will now have to say “Vande Mataram” instead of “Yes, Sir” or “Present, Sir.”The All India Muslim Personal Law Board has expressed outrage at this order, issued last month, by Primary Education Minister Ravindra Shukla. Charging the BJP government with “forcibly imposing the VHP agenda,” the Board has said that Islam prohibits idol worship and, therefore, has asked Muslims across the State not to follow the order.“I know the Government might brand all of us Muslims as traitors after this decision,” says the Board’s legal advisor Zafaryab Jilani. “But we don’t need a certificate for our patriotism from any political party or person.”“Nobody should have any objections to this order which asks them only to hail their mother land,” says Shukla.

He claims it was being done only to “inculcate patriotism among the youth.”However, Shukla, reacting to the Muslims’ outrage, has now said that while reciting Vande Mataram — and saying Vande Mataram during roll call –will be compulsory, the “worship of Bharat Mata” will be “only once or twice a year” since it’s “not feasible every day.”

Incidentally, it was the VHP which a few years ago had raised the slogan: Bharat Varsh main rahna hai to, Vande Mataram kehna hoga. (If you want to live in India, you will have to say Vande Mataram.’)

“It’s common knowledge that no Muslim was ever involved in any espionage case or in the assasination of any leader like Mahatma Gandhi, Indira Gandhi or Rajiv Gandhi,” says Jilani.

Shukla claims he is surprised. “Why are they raising such a brouhaha now while they remained silent when Vande Mataram was made the national song?”The order violates the right to religious freedom as guaranteed by the Constitution and, therefore, can be challenged in a court of law, says Jilani.

A similar reaction inMumbaiin 1973 had forced the then Mayor to withdraw the order for recitation of Vande Mataram in Municipal Corporation schools.The Board also said it was examining the connotations of “Vande Mataram” in the context of Islamic law. “Until then, we have instructed our students not to follow the order,” says Board vice president Kalbe Sadiq. He said the Board would finalise its strategy after seeing what action the Government takes against Muslim students who do not follow the order.

title: The Family Man Season 3 Review LIVE Updates: Manoj Bajpayee confirms Season 4 of spy drama, says ‘Sabka jawab 4th season me hoga’
article_text:
The Family Man 3 Web Series Review Live Updates:The third season of Amazon Prime Video series The Family Man is finally out, and fans around the world are tuning in to see what’s next in Srikant Tiwari’s journey. Tiwari, portrayed by Manoj Bajpayee, has foiled several terrorist plans in the past, but this time, things are a little different. In a dramatic twist, Srikant must now step into the role of the fugitive and go into hiding. The super-agent is forced to stay off the radar while protecting his wife and their two children.

The Family Man 3 Review: Read Here

These unnatural turns of events have been orchestrated by the antagonist Meera, played by actor Nimrat Kaur. She is also using Rukma, played by Jaideep Ahlawat, to make inroads into Northeastern India. Moreover, this time Srikant’s battle against the villains will be much more challenging because, according to the trailer, he has now revealed his true job to his family. Which means that it’s more likely for his family to get caught in the crossfire.

Some things are luckily the same as before. Srikant still has his field partner, J. K. Talpade, played by Sharib Hashmi. Talpade still trusts Srikant and does seem to be holding his own in the trailer while also being chaotically anxious about everything. In this season, Srikant will have to choose between safety and duty. Choosing safety would mean the whole family leaving behind their life and hiding for the rest of their days. Duty would mean taking Rukma and Meera head-on in order to foil their schemes and clear his name.

Directed by Raj and DK, the cast of The Family Man season 3 includes Manoj Bajpayee, Jaideep Ahlawat, Nimrat Kaur, Priyamani, Sharib Hashmi, Ashlesha Thakur, Vedant Sinha, Seema Biswas, Gul Panag, Jugal Hansraj and Vipin Sharma.

User @AdityaRawat1997 took to X and wrote, "Completed Season 3 of The Family Man, and @rajndk world-building continues to impress. They create a universe that feels so real, layered, and engaging. @BajpayeeManoj as Srikant Tiwari single-handedly carries the show with sheer brilliance. His banter with JK aka @sharibhashm adds such a fun. Even the villain has some emotional depth, and the entire cast delivers good performances. @Sumitaroraa dialogues are a standout—witty, fun, and packed with sharp humor. They remain one of the strongest pillars of the show. A fun little cameo pops up in the show-totally enjoyable. Overall, a fun watch—but it’s a slow burn. Stay patient, and it turns into a good ride with a cliffhanger in the finale."

User @DevBilla2 shared on X, "I just wrapped up The Family Man Season 3, and wow, the team has absolutely leveled up the game. Excellent taking from #sumanthkumar.From storytelling to performances, Everything is good. Kudos to @BajpayeeManoj and the entire crew for delivering another masterclass."

A tweed by user @amitabhlaloriya read, "BINGEWATCHED! Why do you do this @rajndk? You are simply the best in creating such cliffhangers of stories! I too, like millions of @BajpayeeManoj die hard fans, desperately waiting for the Season -3 and the desperation - the anxiousness and the restlessness is multi times high after the seventh episode ended!! What to do now ? How could you leave Srikant Tiwari in such a condition? That’s all is still manageable but HOW does one wait to know how is Srikant Tiwari now ? Has he been picked up in time by the army or some saviour?? Please do something quick and fast, Raj & DK!! Bring the SEASON 4 asap! Take A Bow, Team Family Man."

User @Nithish_017 said via X, "Finally watched the most awaited Season 3 this weekend — and Raj & DK have once again levelled up the game on @PrimeVideoIN! This season dives deep into the North-East conflict, deep-state manipulation, 0.5 enemies within, China border tensions, and the brainwashing of border towns. Loved the subtle digs at language learning sarcasm and woke campaigns. The show also beautifully portrays the emotional battles of NIA families — the courage, the distance, the togetherness. Performances: • Manoj Bajpayee as Srikant Tiwari — one of the most legendary characters ever written. Iconic. • Jaideep Ahlawat as Rukma is a beast — his sarcastic alpha energy is a treat. Its intense, and exactly what a good thriller should be. @BajpayeeManoj once again proves that strong acting doesn’t need noise...just honesty. The show reminds us of one simple truth: Life keeps throwing challenges, but staying focused and steady is what makes you a real fighter ...just like Srikant Tiwari. title: Kaunda out of jail but under house arrest
article_text:
LUSAKA, December 31: Jailed Zambian ex-leader Kenneth Kaunda, held under emergency powers over a foiled coup plot, will be freed from prison today and placed under house arrest, President Frederick Chiluba announced.

Chiluba said he would sign an order later today to release Kaunda, 73, after he had received “reasonable requests” from Tanzanian envoy Julius Nyerere and President Robert Mugabe of Zimbabwe. The decision to free Kaunda from a notorious high security prison he has been held in sinceChristmasday was reached following an emergency cabinet meeting last night, prompted by direct appeals from retired Tanzanian leader Nyerere and Mugabe, who is current chairman of the Organisation of African Unity (OAU).

Earlier, Kaunda refused to plead guilty in a court here and accused the ruling regime of plotting to “liquidate” him. The leader of the country’s largest Opposition party told the court he was arrested “to settle political accounts” and did not rule out the “possibility of physical liquidation” by the ruling regime, which has accused him of plotting to overthrow President Frederick Chiluba. The 73-year-old leader, who ruled Zambia with an iron hand from the country’s Independence in 1964 until he was ousted from his post in 1991’s first multi-party polls denies any connection with the failed October coup.

He has ended his hunger strike, Tanzania’s former President Julius Nyerere, who has been asked by several African leaders to mediate Kaunda’s release, said. “Together we had a nice drink of orange juice and a little biscuit. He broke his fast,” Nyerere told reporters after a meeting with old friend Kaunda at the prison in the town of Kabwe.

Meanwhile, according to reports from Washington, the United States today kept up pressure for Kaunda’s release.

title: "Challenges for women" meet begins today
article_text:
CHANDIGARH, January 7: A four-day conference on "Challenges for women in the next millennium", organised by the Asia Pacific Watch (APW), will begin here tomorrow. Mohini Giri, chairperson of the National Commission for Women, will inaugurate the meet while Dr Noeleen Heyzer, executive director of UNIFEM, will deliver the keynote address.

According to the convenor of the Asia Pacific Watch Meet, Prof Pam Rajput, nearly 40 delegates from 17 countries will participate in the meet. She said representatives from Japan, New Zealand, Philippines, Malaysia, Singapore, Bangladesh, Nepal and Sri Lanka would deliberate on the issues under focus — violence against women, women’s rights, women in armed conflict and the girl child.

Ruth Manorama, chairperson of the National Alliance for Women, said India had made four commitments at the Beijing conference.
